shared_elements: head/face at the top of a vertical composition
paired curved/arc elements flanking a central axis
horizontal band across the lower torso (belt-like)
justification: Both are vertical, strictly symmetrical anthropomorphic compositions with a head at the summit, paired curving forms flanking a central axis, disc/ring motifs on the upper body, and a horizontal belt-like band above a widening lower body. The decisive difference is the mode of rendering: A is a crisp, brightly coloured flat outline drawing with explicit feathered wings and textile detail, while B is a weathered, monochrome low-relief carving on a massive stone block whose motifs are abstract and only loosely legible as body parts.
